zh: 发布管线沿用 CHANGELOG 里已有的版本段：打包的版本已经由发布提交写进 CHANGELOG 时，不再插一个只有占位说明的空段，发布说明取完整原文；这一版还有待发布条目时直接报错，不丢条目。
en: The release pipeline reuses the version section already in the CHANGELOG: when the packaged version was recorded by the release commit, it no longer prepends a placeholder-only section and the release notes use the full text; pending fragments for an already recorded version now fail the run instead of being dropped.
